payload.title: Record how hyp makes the /goal prompt: who writes it, and whether it carries owner answers
payload.body: Design record for issue #113, settled by the owner in the grill session of 2026-11-11 (hyp-owner-grill). Two questions: who writes the /goal prompt for a Goal, hyp or a skill; and whether the prompt carries the owner's answers. Each is a DesignQuestion with its rivals, decided in that session with the session as evidence, so the tree says it was argued, not tested. This Goal has no lines and no run: no run checks its candidates. Its cases are the lines of the build Goal in this store that cites its selects.

why: Owner, 2026-11-11: the design record for #113's prompt generator; its build is a second Goal in this store.

payload.title: hyp prints the /goal prompt for a Goal from its log
payload.body:
Builds the design recorded in G-GZR6C6 (selects H-MCDPNB and H-RSDX0H, with grill session 285fa63e as evidence), for issue #113. The candidate is a hyp commit: the read command hyp prompt and the skill text it makes wrong. go test on the candidate decides lines 1 to 5; line 6 is an eval case in ak-skill-creator's format; line 7 runs its pinned scripts. A skill change follows ak-skill-creator's update flow: matched original and candidate consumer runs on the cases its edited lines touch. The fixture copies run 6's prompt (plans/reports/goal-prompt-261111-2129-g1b-run-6.md) and checkpoint-store:G-D1CH1R's events into testdata, because plans/ and investigations/ are not testdata.
May change: this repository, in commits on the branch the prompt names, that follow AGENTS.md (conventional messages, no AI trailers); the run may push that branch and open or update one PR, and never merges it. It changes cmd/, internal/ and their testdata, and the text the change makes wrong: docs/replay-spec.md, docs/glossary.md, docs/principles.md, AGENTS.md, README.md, and skills/ (hyp-owner-grill's hand-off and Goal-body template, hyp-owner-answer's end, hyp-goal-run's practice from run 6, and the descriptions of hyp-goal-run and hyp-prototype).
Read only: plans/, every investigations/ tree except goal-prompt, and ak-skill-creator under .claude/skills, pinned by sha256.
Never: commit to main or merge a PR.
Never: replace ~/.local/bin/hyp or ~/.local/share/hyp/hyp-33896ec; compile the candidate to a separate path.
Never: edit recipes/, rubrics/, another investigations/ tree, ak-skill-creator or another repository.
Never: write under an owner's actor; if a step needs the owner, refer with a reason or record a reading, and stop.

lines.text: [P] For a Goal whose body holds a valid constraints block, hyp prompt <G> --actor A exits 0 and prints the same bytes on every call for the same log and flags: the store's path relative to the repository root, A, G, the skill hyp-goal-run, the stop clauses (the line "runner owes nothing", or N Results recorded under A, N from --experiments, default 5), and each block line byte for byte in body order. --branch and --pr only add clauses after the block.
[N] hyp prompt prints no text of an owner answer: its output for a Goal is byte-identical before and after an answer event is added to the log.

[N] The constraints block runs from the first line that starts with "May change:", "Read only:" or "Never:" to the end of the body. hyp prompt exits 1 and prints nothing to stdout when the block is missing, lacks one of the three headings, or holds a non-empty line that starts with none of them, naming each missing heading or the bad line. hyp add goal still accepts such a body with exit 0, and warns when the body has a heading but no valid block.
[N] In a store with two Goals, where one answer event settles a key of each, hyp prompt G prints the same bytes as for G's events in a store of their own.
[N] hyp prompt with no --actor exits 2 and never falls back to $HYP_ACTOR; an unknown id or a non-Goal id exits 2.

[P] For the testdata fixture (checkpoint-store:G-D1CH1R's events through the owner answer of 2026-11-11 14:31, its Goal body given a constraints block), each clause of run 6's prompt (sha256 94f61179c63cb43ef63169553541d82c5d75d3b7e78cfe7ac9ccf954ca6285e3) is stated by the printed prompt or by hyp-goal-run or a skill it names, except the actor, owner answer, branch, PR, commit and run plan (the Experiment's aims and verdict rule, that run's owner items). Graded by an ak-skill-creator eval case (eval_skill.py sha256 c47a38de…), one rubric assertion per clause, by an independent reviewer.

[P] Each SKILL.md the candidate changes passes ak-skill-creator's quick_validate.py (sha256 d81f883a…) with 0 errors and lint_cruft.py --routing (sha256 ff36baef…) with no High finding, and skillcheck passes.

payload.title: A budget-bound build run ends with its final candidate reviewed, without a review chain on small changes
payload.body:
For issue #141 (part of #113). The candidate is a hyp commit over main 9c8e498b87683e50a94a410b6a3cfecdd7a0d441 that changes the run practice of a build Goal (review, budget, stop) in skills/hyp-goal-run, or hyp prompt's default N. Owner's prediction: H-whole-candidate is contradicted on cost.
Cut A: this store as of 01M75T1YRF2R2Z99DX0E8JQPWG (R-8JQPWG), actor claude-g113-1, code at b4f23b2. Cut B: as of 01M76V52SZ9DMCYFVYFRJEGDSA (run 2's stop), a fresh actor, code at 3cfd08d.
A trial replays a cut under the recipe the run builds, on Sonnet, with the method stated in the Question's body.
A review Result gives a verdict on a candidate and cites a review written by a subagent whose transcript in the trial read that candidate's diff.
May change: this repository, in commits on the branch the prompt names, in a worktree separate from the checkout ~/.claude/skills links to, following AGENTS.md; the run may push that branch and open or update one PR, and never merges it.
May change: skills/hyp-goal-run and the text the change makes wrong (skills/, docs/, AGENTS.md, README.md); cmd/, internal/ and testdata for H-raise-budget only; a new recipes/ directory.
Read only: plans/, every investigations/ tree except goal-prompt, ak-skill-creator under .claude/skills.
Never: commit to main or merge a PR.
Never: replace an installed hyp; compile each candidate to a separate path.
Never: edit an existing recipe version, rubrics/, another tree, .claude/skills or another repository.
Never: let a trial reach a remote, or run one on a model other than Sonnet except the one Opus trial.
Never: write under an owner's actor; if a step needs the owner, refer with a reason or record a reading, and stop.

lines.text: [P] Replayed from cut A with the candidate's default N, the run stops with every candidate it built having a review Result, in at least 2 of 3 trials.
[P] Replayed from cut B with the candidate's default N, the run selects a candidate that has a review Result before its budget ends, in at least 2 of 3 trials.

[N] At cut A or cut B, the median total_cost_usd of 3 trials under the candidate is never more than 1.5 times the median under the base at the same cut. The base is skills/hyp-goal-run/SKILL.md sha256 cb15e2f2e207b5a66807c9369e4d776d5378e61c2dd99679c36dfba402fa750e with default N 5; the candidate differs from it in skill text or N.
[N] In no trial at cut A or cut B does the run stop with a candidate that has no review Result unless its stop checkpoint names that candidate.

[P] Each SKILL.md the candidate changes passes ak-skill-creator's quick_validate.py (sha256 d81f883a9ddbb87fa2b015781e42041811cb14750dd3a703cfaeca409c1d7247) with 0 errors and lint_cruft.py --routing (sha256 ff36baefb5aa720b3e74a4c3f71df3cdb1c88d320e8296f25ce1b961660a0946) with no High finding, and skillcheck passes.
